acceptance_oracle: When a job first becomes available to a career profile, the Activity timeline records JOB_DISCOVERED and MATCH_SCORED with safe job/company context. Re-scoring is idempotent for the same profile version; another profile has independent events. The API and UI expose no raw audit payload or match score.
red_observation: Before this slice, the connected timeline returned no JOB_DISCOVERED or MATCH_SCORED events after fixture discovery and the regression tests failed on both missing event types.
implementation: Fixture discovery and deterministic match recalculation append profile-owned JOB_DISCOVERED and MATCH_SCORED audit rows in the same transaction as profile match persistence.
Stable event IDs and conflict-do-nothing inserts prevent duplicate retries while preserving existing audit rows; a new profile gets independent first-seen history.
The Activity read model resolves job title/company through stored job rows, returns fixed summaries only, and never serializes event payloads, profile-version identifiers or scores.
The profile-level MATCHES_RECALCULATED summary remains distinct from per-job MATCH_SCORED events.
